source: ICMR-NIN Recommended Dietary Allowances and Estimated Average Requirements for Indians, 2020 (sedentary adults; sexes averaged per age band)
status: hypothesis: ratify in the handbook 08 update before planner v1 (M10 F14)
notes: under_5 averages the 1-3 y (1110 kcal, 12.5 g) and 4-6 y (1360 kcal, 16 g) RDA rows
5_17 averages 7-9 y, 10-12 y, 13-15 y and 16-18 y rows for boys and girls
18_59 averages the sedentary man (2110 kcal, 54 g) and woman (1660 kcal, 46 g)
60_plus uses the sedentary adult values less 10 % energy
fibre follows the ICMR-NIN guide of about 15 g per 1000 kcal
